definitions.explanation: A state of tranquility or freedom from war.

examples.japanese: {世界|せかい}{平和|へいわ}を{願|ねが}っている。
{平和|へいわ}な{生活|せいかつ}を{送|おく}りたい。
examples.english: I want to live a peaceful life.

notes: Functions as a noun and な-adjective. Related: {平和的|へいわてき} (peaceful), {平和主義|へいわしゅぎ} (pacifism).
